pages.text: The $(d)Biome Radar$() is a multiblock structure that helps you find biomes in the world.$(br2)First, you have to actually build the structure:

Then, insert a $(d)Biome Crystal$(). There's one for each Biome in the game, and they can be found in basically any chest with loot.$(br2)If the biome exists in the world, the fires on top of the Iron Bars will start blowing in its direction. If that's not enough, you can use a $(l:irregular_implements:items/location_filter)Location Filter$(/l) on it to set it to the biome's location.
With that, you can craft it with a $(l:irregular_implements:items/golden_compass)Golden Compass$(/l) to make your way there!
